Tim — thanks for the quick follow-up and for sending the W9 + bank letter. Attachments look good at a glance.

High-level plan and answers: 

1) ACH micro-deposit test schedule
   - We can run the micro-deposit on Thursday 2028-07-13 at 11:00 PT. Ben (payments) will execute the test and confirm the two deposits (amounts will be in cents). Please confirm that window or propose an alternate.

2) Remittance mapping
   - Redwood expects a remittance CSV with the following columns by default: remit_id, invoice_number, po_number, amount, invoice_date, vendor_account_id.
   - We will also accept a single-line remittance string if that's how your AR system sends it; Ben can map it to the CSV fields on our side.

3) PO linkage and payment routing
   - To ensure automatic PO matching, please include the PO number exactly as it appears on Redwood POs (case-insensitive). If you expect multiple invoice numbers per PO, include all invoice_numbers (comma-separated) in the CSV.

Next steps (what we'll do):
- Ben will run the ACH micro-deposit on 2028-07-13 11:00 PT and send confirmation.
- Once deposits are confirmed, we'll kick a small initial pay-run (first live remittance) and share a sample remittance CSV for you to validate mapping.

I attached our Remit_CSV_Template.csv and a short checklist. If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute screen-share after the micro-deposit to walk through field mapping.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Goldstream routed.

Irene Choi
